scope: Provisional MicroDuck plus Tab5 UART assembly. No actual hardware measured.

radxa_zero_3w.cad_revision: Official download labels v1.11 production; STEP internal FILE_NAME is ZREO_3W with timestamp 2024-04-25
radxa_zero_3w.pcb_dimensions_evidence: 65x30 and four diameter2.8 mounting holes labeled on product-brief mechanical drawing. Thickness1.6 extracted from official STEP cylindrical mounting-hole faces spanning z=-1.6..0.
radxa_zero_3w.coordinates: Original STEP mm coordinates; PCB nominal x=0..65, y=0..30, top z=0, bottom z=-1.6; connector ports along negative y side; 40-pin header along positive y side.

mounting_holes_mm.evidence: Official STEP radius1.4 through-hole cylinder centers agree with official DXF footprint centers; small asymmetry preserved. Do not replace with assumed Raspberry Pi Zero58x23 pattern. Tolerances not specified.

cad_all_geometry_bbox_mm.evidence: OCCT BoundingBox on complete imported official STEP shape, including shell geometry. Imported shape validity test is false. Suitable envelope reference, not mass model.

header.evidence: Pad coordinates from DXF circles; tips from STEP planes. Exact pin-number-to-coordinate orientation not established confidently. Logical pins16/18 are UART4_RX_M1/UART4_TX_M1 but electrical availability/physical access with Robot HAT is unverified.

usb_c.orientation: Both along negative-y edge. Plug insertion and cable envelope beyond connector not supplied.
usb_c.caveat: CAD-derived centerline geometry; product-brief mechanical figure has nominal centers41.5 and54.7. Revision/geometry discrepancy requires measurement before port-cutout manufacture.

radxa_zero_3w.mass_note: No official bare-board mass found in reviewed Radxa sources. Any dynamic-model mass is an explicit assumption, not a manufacturer figure.
radxa_zero_3w.mesh_caveat: Source has invalid/open or nonmanifold geometry. Visual only; no use for physical mass, collision validation, or printing. No license conclusion drawn.

tab5.coordinates: Rear landscape orthographic dimension view with battery bay left: x right from left edge0..128, y down from top edge0..80. Rear connector mating direction is outward normal to screen plane.

m5bus.orientation: Rear photo and official LEFT/RIGHT table indicate odd column toward battery bay/lower x and even column toward main PCB/higher x; first rowGND/G16 at top, final rowHVIN/BAT at bottom.
m5bus.central_row: Pins15/16, G7 PC_RX and G6 PC_TX, near y40; requires hardware verification before wiring.
m5bus.caveat: Housing location/dimensions and pin-grid coordinates are drawing-scaled estimates, not labeled connector dimensions. The2.54 grid is inferred. Header insertion depth and mated plug/cable keepout unknown.

j7_extport2.location: Rear face immediately to the main-PCB side of M5Bus; white6-pin receptacle below RS485 termination switch in official rear view. Not an exterior side port.
j7_extport2.power_pins: pin1GND, pin2SYS_VIN/HVIN;6-24V range per Tab5 docs and pinmap
j7_extport2.caveat: Center/housing size are image-derived only. Exact mating connector series, insertion height, wire colors, and cable envelope not established.

tab5.official_stl_caveat: Tab5_official.stl was downloaded from M5_Hardware master/Products/C145_Tab5/Structures. Parent inspection reports exploded/disjoint layout,128x556.44x12 overall; must not insert as assembled product.

microduck_retained_stack.evidence: Official code states Radxa Zero3W uses Robot HAT I2C on header3/5 and in-robot power comes from battery via HAT. Therefore do not delete HAT/controller/power-board representation merely because bare SBC fits.
microduck_retained_stack.unknown: HAT dimensions, board offsets, stacking height, connector occupation, harness service clearance, power-branch access and mass are unverified. Reserve explicit provisional keepout and mass assumptions.
microduck_retained_stack.hardware_files_note: Official press kit says open-source statement covers software; mechanical and electronic design files are not open.

protection_branch.recommendation: Use an explicitly provisional protection-module keepout. No fuse/holder product or rating selected; do not imply validated branch protection.
